query: Review NewsScreen.kt in this directory. The list stutters while scrolling and the read counter sometimes does not update on screen. Tell me exactly what is wrong and show the fixes.
expected_behavior: Flags that @Immutable Article holds a var and a MutableList, so the annotation is a broken contract that causes silently missed recompositions, and fixes it with val plus an immutable/persistent collection rather than only calling it a performance problem

Explains that under strong skipping (Kotlin 2.0.20+) an unstable List<Article> parameter is compared with === so a freshly allocated list still defeats skipping, instead of claiming stability no longer matters
Replaces items(articles) with a keyed overload (key = { it.id }) and explains that index identity discards composition state and scroll restoration on insert/remove
Replaces collectAsState with collectAsStateWithLifecycle for the ViewModel StateFlow, and says the Flow<String> parameter on BannerBar must not be passed into a composable at all
Replaces the direct listState.firstVisibleItemIndex read with derivedStateOf (or snapshotFlow) and explains the input-changes-far-more-often-than-output rule

Replaces Modifier.offset(y = dp) with the lambda overload Modifier.offset { IntOffset(...) } (or graphicsLayer) and explains that the lambda defers the state read from Composition to the Layout or Draw phase
Flags that .clickable before .padding makes the padding area tappable and that .background after .padding paints only the inner bounds, and gives the corrected chain order

query: We want to move this module to Android Gradle Plugin 9. Read app-build.gradle.kts and libs.versions.toml in this directory and give me the concrete migration steps for this build script.

Says custom BuildConfig fields require buildFeatures { buildConfig = true } and that a String BuildConfigField value must carry its own escaped quotation marks
Says getDefaultProguardFile("proguard-android.txt") is no longer supported and must become proguard-android-optimize.txt, because proguard-android.txt carries -dontoptimize

Names the minimum Gradle and JDK versions AGP 9 requires (Gradle 9.1, JDK 17) and gives a verification step such as a Gradle sync plus ./gradlew build --dry-run
